title: Two electrons per orbital, opposite spins
caption: Helium's two electrons share 1s with opposite spins. Lithium's third electron cannot enter 1s, which is full, so it starts 2s. Nitrogen's 2p electrons are each in their own box.
alt: Box diagrams: helium 1s²; lithium 1s² 2s¹; nitrogen 1s² 2s² 2p³ with three single 2p electrons.
description: Helium: one 1s box with an up and a down arrow.
Lithium: 1s paired, 2s with a single up arrow.
Nitrogen: 1s and 2s paired, three 2p boxes each with one up arrow.
